facts.conditions: SN74HC00 free-air TA=-40 to 85 C. Limits apply to each input transition, not propagation delay or permitted clock period; Figure 7-3 measures rise/fall between 10% and 90%. Standard CMOS input transition limits must be met: slow edges can increase consumption and cause oscillation. This is not a Schmitt-trigger specification. Actual controller edges, pull network and capacitance remain unknown.

facts.conditions: Section 6.5 commercial 74xx columns; VI=VIH or VIL. Negative IOH denotes source current; positive IOL denotes sink current. Typical values are not guaranteed limits. These are DC output-level test conditions at VCC=4.5 V, not an unrestricted drive-current maximum, rail-to-rail guarantee, switching-time bound or all-channel thermal qualification. Do not substitute the section 6.6 SN54HC00 temperature/voltage columns.

facts.conditions: Section 6.1 stress ratings only; output current row requires VO=0 to VCC. SN74HC00 selected operating free-air range is -40 to 85 C. Supply and ground paths must also accommodate static and switching current along with sourced/sunk load current; all electrical/thermal limits still apply.

value.unused_output: Leave disconnected; do not connect directly to VCC or GND.
value.contention: Do not directly connect push-pull outputs that can reach opposing states, even briefly.
value.light_load_caveat: Fast output edges require routing/load review for ringing.

facts.conditions: The 50-pF recommendation is section 9.2.1.1 application guidance, not an absolute-maximum damage threshold or a board-level timing guarantee. Section 9 notes application information is not part of the component specification and requires design validation. Section 7 includes probe/fixture capacitance in CL. Load current also changes output levels; actual capacitance, receiver thresholds, routing, frequency and switching simultaneity are unknown. No numerical propagation-delay budget or automatic output-paralleling permission is derived.
